organiser_enquiry.body:
Dear Anthology programme team,

I am researching the public architecture network around the 2–4 October 2026 festival in Intramuros for Proxy Society, an architectural research proposal about AI-delegated civic access and chosen human presence.

I found both programme PDFs linked from your site. They differ on several Shelter Dialogues names, including Mybelle Aragon-GoBio, while public reports advertise 128 speakers. I have also identified the HKU Ground Works leads and publicly credited installation teams.

Could you point me to the final public roster of speakers, moderators, workshop leads, Anthology RAW presenters, curators, competition jurors/winners and installation teams, along with any public recordings or approved professional contact routes? A public programme or credits page would be ideal; I am not requesting private attendee details.

I would also appreciate the right WTA Labs or programme contact for a small architectural research enquiry about thresholds, co-design and human handoff.

Best wishes,
Kris Haamer
Proxy Society
https://proxysociety.org/architecture
